cli.finalMessage:
Built the beneficiaries screen using semantic HTML, native checkboxes/inputs, and inline SVG icons, styled with Strata design tokens (with safe fallbacks) and logical CSS properties so it adapts across brands, light/dark, and RTL locales.

Summary of what's implemented in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `Screen.module.css`:
- A sortable table (Name, Bank, Account, Added) with mock beneficiary data; clicking a column header toggles ascending/descending sort with a directional icon.
- Per-row checkbox selection plus a header "select all" checkbox.
- A selection bar that appears only when rows are selected, showing the count and a "Remove selected" action.
- Icon-only edit and remove buttons per row; edit switches the row into inline text inputs with save/cancel icon actions, remove deletes that row (and clears it from selection).

I couldn't run or typecheck the app since `node_modules` isn't installed in this environment, and `@strata/react`/`@strata/icons` weren't inspectable, so I deliberately avoided importing unknown component APIs and built with plain HTML + CSS Modules against Strata's CSS tokens instead — worth a look-over once the real component library is available in case you'd prefer swapping in actual Strata `Table`/`Button`/`Checkbox` components.
